title: Turn-end prompt (one-shot)
description: One-shot DONE hook that injects a follow-up prompt when the current turn finishes, then removes itself.
notes: The template behind the /done command, installable directly when you want to customize it: install with --text "your follow-up" (or edit the default text afterwards). single_use deletes the hook after its first successful fire, so it cannot re-fire after a restart; once keeps it silent for the rest of the turn's thread scratch lifetime as a belt-and-braces guard. Installs thread-scoped by default; the prompt re-drives the turn via the DONE-continue mechanism (bounded by the continuation cap).

params.text: Before finishing: review this turn's work, verify the results hold, and fix or flag anything incomplete.
